title: kya hua ali akber
body:
Roke kehte the sarwar kya hua Ali Akber
Kis taraf ho aye dilbar kya hua Ali Akber
Aau'n mai kidhar bolo Phir pukaaro baba ko
Dhoondu'n kis jagah jaakar kya hua Ali Akber
<<DIVIDER>>
Dast o paa me resha hai, aankho'n me andhera hai
Aye shabihe paighambar kya hua Ali Akber
Kisne kardiya ghaayal haaye sher ko mere
zalimo kaho aaqar kya hua Ali Akber
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum ho naujawaa'n beta mai zaeefo muztar hu
aao ya Ali kehkar kya hua Ali Akber
Bano kehti thi rokar gham me tere aye dilbar
kya jiegi ye maadar kya hua Ali Akber
<<DIVIDER>>
maa khadi hai dyodi par teri muntazar akber
kya jawaab du jaakar kya hua Ali Akber
Asqiyaa'n bhi rote the saif sheh ke rone par
Jab ye kehte the sarwar kya hua Ali Akber
